title: SentinelRuleFile
description: Schema for Sentinel AI Bridge rule definition files. Validates the structure of default_rules.json and any custom rule files.

version.description: Schema version of the rule file. Increment when rule format changes.

description.description: Human-readable description of the rule set's purpose.

rules.description: Ordered list of rules evaluated by the RulesEngine.

id.description: Unique snake_case identifier for the rule.

enabled.description: Whether this rule is currently active.

priority.description: Evaluation priority. Higher values are evaluated first within the same phase.

phase.description: Pipeline phase in which this rule is evaluated.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this rule does.

match.description: Criteria that determine whether the rule triggers.

contains.description: List of substrings to match against input content (case-insensitive). Any match triggers the rule.

confidenceBelow.description: Matches when overall result confidence is below this threshold.

confidenceAbove.description: Matches when overall result confidence is above this threshold. Used with confidenceBelow to define a range.

taskConfidenceBelow.description: Matches individual tasks with confidence below this threshold.

source.description: Optional event source filter (e.g., CALL, NOTIFICATION).

action.description: Action to take when the rule matches. IGNORE silently drops input. REJECT produces an error. FLAG marks for review. TRANSFORM modifies the result. PASS allows through.

transform.description: Transformation to apply when action is TRANSFORM. Required when action is TRANSFORM.
